input.title: Connect modals are driven imperatively from editors via showPHModal and the PHModal discriminated union

input.description: usePHModal reads the current modal; showPHModal, closePHModal, showCreateDocumentModal and showDeleteNodeModal control it. Source has 17 union members; the academy documents 13.

input.content:
Connect's modals are global state, not React context, so an editor opens one by calling a plain function rather than rendering a component. There is no `<Modal>` to mount and no provider to wrap.

Five entry points:

- `usePHModal(): PHModal | undefined` — reads whichever modal is currently displayed
- `showPHModal(modal: PHModal)` — displays one; it is literally `setPHModal(modal)`
- `closePHModal()` — `setPHModal(undefined)`
- `showCreateDocumentModal(documentType)` and `showDeleteNodeModal(nodeOrId)` — typed shortcuts for the two cases editors reach for most

`PHModal` is a discriminated union on `type`, with the payload each modal needs carried alongside. Source (`packages/reactor-browser/src/types/modals.ts`) has **17** members: `createDocument` (with an optional `documentModelVersion`), `deleteItem`, `addDrive`, `upgradeDrive`, `deleteDrive`, `driveSettings`, `settings`, `clearStorage`, `debugSettings`, `disclaimer`, `cookiesPolicy`, `downloadDocumentWithErrors`, `inspector`, `missingPackage`, `documentVersionUnsupported`, `confirmDocumentUpgrade`, and `driveAuthRequired`.

```tsx
<button onClick={() => showCreateDocumentModal("powerhouse/budget-statement")}>
  Create Budget Statement
</button>
```

Because it is a union, `showPHModal` is type-safe on the payload — `showPHModal({ type: "deleteItem" })` will not compile — and the same call is how built-in UI works: `ToolbarUpgradeButton` fires `showPHModal({ type: "confirmDocumentUpgrade", documentId })`, and `{ type: "inspector" }` is the programmatic route to the Inspector Modal.

**Documentation caveat:** `01-ReactHooks.md` prints a 13-member union. It omits `missingPackage`, `documentVersionUnsupported`, `confirmDocumentUpgrade` and `driveAuthRequired`, misses `documentModelVersion` on `createDocument`, and names one member `exportDocumentWithErrors` where source says `downloadDocumentWithErrors`. Take member names from source.

_Source: packages/reactor-browser/src/types/modals.ts and src/hooks/modals.ts, cross-checked against apps/academy/docs/academy/04-Reference/05-EditorsUI/01-ReactHooks.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45)._
